description.value: La Taquisa is a family-run Mexican restaurant serving scratch-made, home-style tacos and dishes from fresh, local ingredients and hormone- and antibiotic-free local meats. It has two Victoria locations — downtown on Blanshard Street and a second outpost in Vic West — and bills itself as the city's most authentic Mexican fare. Catering with a fully customizable build-your-own taco bar is also available for events.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms La Taquisa is a real, operating Mexican restaurant with two Victoria locations, including the OSM-listed downtown address at 1017 Blanshard St (phone 250-889-5803 confirmed on /contact page). The site features 'Order Now' / 'Order Online' buttons confirming takeout availability, and a catering page confirms that service. No evidence was found on the website for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific amenities, so all are null. A concern is that the /privacy/ subpage serves content for a completely unrelated business ('Custom Cabinets in Nanaimo BC'), indicating a mis-configured website template from their marketing agency (Atlas Marketing Canada).
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; phone 250-889-5803 sourced from website /contact page for the downtown location.

The /privacy/ subpage serves content for an entirely different business ('Custom Cabinets in Nanaimo BC') operated by Atlas Marketing Canada, indicating a mis-configured website template. The main site content for La Taquisa itself appears correct and consistent.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating Mexican restaurant in downtown Victoria with a confirmed address and active website. A useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a meal.
